scope: MTP M2/M3 coupled Gate/Up N17408 K5120; ordinary nonMTP, M4 and other projections unchanged
product_constraint: Close cap2 P65/O16 >=1.5x matched nonMTP; keep cap3 and exact target state/full logits/output; report Prefill, TTFT, Decode and total together.

downward_budget.scope: Historical API/profiler opportunity envelope; no predicted gain or bandwidth ceiling

lineage: Prior v33/v95 assigned Gate and Up to different warps and shared a publication buffer. This fixed design puts both complete four-output accumulator sets in the SAME thread, so activation loads and BF16-to-FP32 conversions serve both roles directly. No shared pair publication or cross-role barrier. No geometry/stage or decoder-table scan.
equivalence: Preserve each role original lane K subsequences, four FP32 FMA chains, parenthesized merge and warp_sum_four reduction. Apply separate tensor scales, BF16_RNE Gate and Up, then original FP32 SiLU multiply and BF16_RNE output. Original packed sidecars, scale/pair tables and K512 input ring remain. No reassociation or target state change.
ownership: 128 threads, four warps; each thread owns eight output channels across two roles. Common M-row two-stage input ring, each input loaded and converted once for both sets. No new allocation, weight owner, scratch, model inventory or request lifetime.
trade: Halves role-duplicated input loads/conversion, ring/table initialization and tile barriers; removes global intermediate publication and two launches/layer. Doubles accumulator count and increases register pressure. Source work counts are not measured speedup.
validation: First compile one fixed implementation. Resource failure closes before GPU, with no launch-bound/register repair. If admitted: complete original Gate+Up+SiLU numerical/guards/Graph/synchronization checks, then P65 complete scalar target-state/logits/transactions, then immediate sealed cap2 P65/O16 API. Must reach >=1.5x frozen conservative native 9.59288889123 token/s; failure removes. Positive direction unlocks 8K/40K and cap3 regression, then independent selection.
bounds: One implementation and at most one correctness repair after static admission; no resource/geometry/policy scan. No production or goal completion from local correctness or timing.
reference_translation: Native original scalar equations and prior pinned vLLM/Marlin paired-MLP producer-consumer study; direct register consumption replaces shared role exchange. No imported source or runtime dependency; FLA/Mamba recurrent and FlashInfer Attention boundaries unchanged.
